ValidationRule.description: Checks whether the user has filled only one field or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), OR(ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Incorrect Destination'),ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c ,'Diversion')), OR(AND(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_CurrentDestinationLocation__c ),ISBLANK(PMC_SS_CurrentDestinationShipTo__c )),AND(NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_CurrentDestinationLocation__c )),NOT(ISBLANK(PMC_SS_CurrentDestinationShipTo__c )))),NOT(ISPICKVAL(Origin , 'Email')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only fill either one of them, Current Destination Location or Current Destination Ship To
